goal: Bootstrap the project, configure tooling, define the database schema, and set up authentication and i18n.
summary: Phase 1 completed. Foundation in place: Next.js 14.2.35 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4.17 + shadcn/ui, Prisma 6.19.3 with SQLite schema and seed, NextAuth v4 credentials auth, next-intl en/zh-Hant routing, shared locale layout with nav/footer/language switcher, and admin login page. Build, lint, and seed all pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Initialize Next.js 14+ with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, App Router; install shadcn/ui and base components. Creates package.json, app/, components/ui/, lib/, prisma/. [verified]
  2. Configure Prisma with SQLite and define schema for User, Course, Booking, BlogPost, SiteContent, Payment, and Availability. Creates prisma/schema.prisma and a seed script. [verified]
  3. Configure NextAuth.js/Auth.js credentials provider for admin login; add admin seed script at scripts/seed.ts. Creates app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts. [verified]
  4. Configure next-intl with messages/en.json and messages/zh-Hant.json; set up middleware.ts and locale routing. Creates i18n config files. [verified]
  5. Add shared layout with navigation shell, footer, and language switcher. Creates app/[locale]/layout.tsx and components/layout/. [verified]
evidence: All 5 steps completed. Added app/[locale]/admin/login/page.tsx and components/admin-login-form.tsx with Suspense boundary to satisfy the admin gate wiring. Updated lib/auth.ts signIn path to /en/admin/login. Build passes and generates /en/admin/login and /zh-Hant/admin/login; lint exits 0; seed creates admin + sample course.
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Every step included real behavioral verification: npm run build, npx prisma migrate dev, npm run db:seed. The lint command uses installed eslint directly and passes.
gateVerdicts.evidence: Build passed after each step and after login page fix; migration created dev.db; seed upserted admin and sample course; `npm run lint` exits 0.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Combined output delivers the phase goal: project scaffolding, database schema, auth, i18n, and admin login entry point are functional and build cleanly.
gateVerdicts.evidence: npm run build exits 0 and registers /[locale]/admin/login; app/[locale]/layout.tsx renders with nav/footer/language switcher; /api/auth/[...nextauth] route registered; Prisma client generated from schema.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Nothing deferred. The Next.js version downgrade was recorded as decision D001 and executed within the phase. The admin login page was added during phase completion to wire the admin gate.
gateVerdicts.evidence: Decision D001 documented; no remaining steps listed in any agent report; admin login page now exists.
